subject: Initial SOC 2 Type II request + guidance on what to share and bridge options
messages:
From: Alice Brooks <alice.brooks@acme-analytics.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: security@acme-analytics.com
Date: 2025-08-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II + bridge letter (audit period clarification)

Hi Jonas —

We’re kicking off our vendor assurance review for Acme Analytics and need a few items from Redwood to complete our SOC2 intake. Can you confirm the following and share the appropriate materials?

1) Do you have a SOC 2 Type II report covering a 12-month audit period (please state the exact start/end dates).
2) If the audit period does not exactly match Jan 1–Dec 31, 2024, will Redwood provide a bridge letter to cover any gap?
3) Minimal evidence list — can you share a short checklist of the most common artifacts (policy snapshots, access logs, retention config, incident response timeline) and whether you can provide redacted artifacts by default?
4) Preferred secure transfer method (S3 presigned URLs, SFTP, or vendor portal) and any file naming conventions we should expect.
5) Target timeline — we’d like materials within 10 business days if possible.

Attached is our intake form (ACME_SOC2_Request_Form.pdf). If you prefer, we can schedule a 20-minute call to align.

Thanks,
Alice Brooks
Vendor Assurance Manager
Acme Analytics
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Alice Brooks <alice.brooks@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2025-08-23T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II + bridge letter (audit period clarification)

Hi Alice —

Thanks for the clear intake. Quick answers up front, then a suggested low-friction path.

1) Current Redwood SOC 2 Type II report covers 2024-04-01 through 2025-03-31 (CPA firm: Bluepoint).
2) Yes — we provide a bridge letter for customers/partners when audit dates don’t align. The bridge letter confirms controls continue to operate outside the formal audit window and calls out any material changes. I’ve attached a draft bridge letter you can use as a starting point (SOC2_Bridge_Letter_DRAFT.docx).
3) Minimal evidence priority matrix (short):
   A — Always-provide (high priority): System access policy, change management policy, last 30 days of IAM logs (redacted), incident response timeline for open incidents, encryption-at-rest config snapshot.
   B — Often-provide (medium): Backups run log, retention policy excerpt, vulnerability scan summary (last quarter).
   C — On request (low): Full config exports, raw telemetry (we can provide samples).

   Note: for initial intake we recommend A + the CPA report + bridge letter. That typically satisfies vendor review teams and reduces back-and-forth.

4) Preferred transfer: presigned S3 links by default (we can also do SFTP). Naming convention: accountname/documenttype_YYYYMMDD_v1.pdf (we’ll include an evidence_manifest.csv with checksums).

5) Timeline: we can assemble the minimal A-bundle within 5 business days after you confirm the transfer method and recipient email. Full A+B within 10–12 business days.

Quick reply templates you can use externally (one-line):
   • "Presigned S3 links preferred — please provide recipient email and desired expiry (default 7 days)."
   • "We accept an A-bundle (report + bridge letter + A artifacts) in 5 business days; please confirm."

Next steps (recommended): you confirm presigned S3, provide recipient email(s) and we’ll stage the artifacts. If you prefer a quick sync, I’m free 8/24 10:00–11:00 PT or 8/25 14:00–15:00 PT.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Head of Trust & Compliance (on Sales eng rotation)
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Brooks <alice.brooks@acme-analytics.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2025-08-24T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II + bridge letter (audit period clarification)

Hi Alice —

Looping in a short checklist and some quick reply snippets your procurement/security team can drop into their tool. I’ll own the evidence staging once we confirm transfer.

Evidence checklist (initial A-bundle):
 - Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_Report_Bluepoint_2024-04-01_2025-03-31.pdf (final report)
 - SOC2_Bridge_Letter_FINAL_signed.pdf (finalized on acceptance)
 - iam_policy_snapshot_20250820.pdf (policy excerpt)
 - access_logs_redacted_30days_20250725-20250824.csv (redacted by user id and IP blocks)
 - incident_response_summary_Q2-Q3_2025.pdf (timeline + remediation)
 - evidence_manifest_template.csv (includes filename, size, sha256, brief description)

Transfer options we support: presigned S3 (preferred), SFTP, or secure portal link. For presigned S3 we’ll issue links scoped to your recipient and set 7-day expiry unless you request otherwise. We do not share KMS keys; all artifacts are exported snapshots and logs with redactions as noted.

One-line reply snippets for your intake system:
 - "Please send recipient email for presigned S3 links; default expiry 7 days."
 - "We will provide A-bundle within 5 business days after recipient confirmation."
 - "If you require additional artifacts beyond the A-bundle, please add them to the request and we’ll provide an ETA."

Internal delegation snippet (use if you need to escalate inside Redwood):
 - "@security: please pull iam_policy_snapshot (20250820) and access_logs_redacted for Acme intake HS-47291 — target staging by EOD +5 business days."

Attachments: I’ve attached evidence_manifest_template.csv and a draft bridge letter.

If presigned links are confirmed, I’ll generate the manifest and the first set of presigned links and send over a short transfer email with the links and checksums.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Alice Brooks <alice.brooks@acme-analytics.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2025-08-25T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II + bridge letter (audit period clarification)

Thanks Jonas / Marissa — this is exactly what we needed.

We confirm presigned S3 links and the recipient for staging is security@acme-analytics.com. Default 7-day expiry is fine. Please include the evidence_manifest.csv and SHA256 checksums in the transfer email.

Two quick clarifications before you stage:
 - Can you confirm that KMS keys are never shared with recipients and that artifacts will be exports/snapshots only (no key material)?
 - Will you include a short note in the transfer email indicating whether any artifacts were redacted and for what reason (PII/IP masking)?

If you can send the A-bundle by EOD next Thursday (2025-08-28), that works for our review cycle. We can do the short 20-minute call on 8/25 at 14:30 PT if you have 15–20 minutes — please send a calendar invite.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Alice Brooks
Vendor Assurance Manager
Acme Analytics
